one_line: Classical Ayurvedic teacher Punarvasu Atreya and physician-redactor Charaka in a Himalayan learning scene.

appearance.age_look: Atreya: dignified elder in his late 60s, lean; Charaka: serious scholar-physician in his late 30s, medium build.
appearance.face: Atreya has an oval face, warm medium-brown complexion, fine wrinkles at eyes and forehead, calm half-smile and observant eyes; Charaka has a slightly angular face, similar medium-brown complexion, sharper brows, thoughtful intense gaze and a focused, composed expression.
appearance.hair: Atreya’s hair is long, straight and silver-grey, tied in a high, neat topknot with a plain dark brown cloth band; a thin, well-kept silver beard follows his jaw and chin. Charaka’s hair is black, straight and shoulder-length, parted in the middle and pulled back loosely; he is clean-shaven, sometimes with a few loose strands framing his face.
appearance.costume: Atreya wears a simple, era-accurate northern Indian sage’s attire: an ankle-length off‑white cotton dhoti wrapped securely from waist to feet, with neat pleats at the front, paired with a long‑sleeved, close‑necked light beige cotton upper tunic reaching mid‑thigh; over this he drapes a Himalayan‑style plain ochre woolen shawl over both shoulders, one end crossing his chest and the other hanging down his left side. Charaka wears a more urban physician’s outfit: an ankle‑length soft cream dhoti wrapped firmly, a fitted, long‑sleeved pale grey cotton tunic that reaches to just above the knee and ties with a simple fabric belt, and a deep green woolen shawl folded lengthwise and worn over the left shoulder and across the chest, leaving his right arm free for writing and examination. Both are modestly, fully clothed, feet in simple brown leather sandals, and each has a thin wooden bead bracelet at the right wrist; textiles are plain, with only subtle woven borders on shawls and no flashy patterns.
appearance.signature: A single, carefully bound palm‑leaf medical manuscript: Atreya holds it in his left hand as a teaching text, while Charaka supports the other end with his right hand, the bundle tightly tied with a dark cord and the carved wooden cover plainly visible.

ref_desc: Atreya is a silver‑haired elder in off‑white dhoti, beige tunic and ochre shawl beside Charaka, a black‑haired scholar in cream dhoti, pale grey tunic and deep green shawl, both in brown sandals jointly holding a bound palm‑leaf manuscript in off‑white, ochre and green tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two north Indian classical Ayurvedic figures standing together in a Himalayan teaching setting: Punarvasu Atreya as a lean elder with an oval, medium-brown face, fine wrinkles, calm half-smile, silver-grey hair in a high, neat topknot and a thin silver beard, fully clothed in an ankle-length off-white dhoti, long-sleeved light beige tunic and a plain ochre woolen shawl draped over both shoulders, wearing simple brown leather sandals and a thin wooden bead bracelet; beside him Charaka, a medium-built younger man with an angular medium-brown face, sharper brows, intense thoughtful gaze, shoulder-length straight black hair parted in the middle and loosely tied back, clean-shaven, dressed modestly in an ankle-length cream dhoti, fitted long-sleeved pale grey tunic tied with a fabric belt, and a deep green woolen shawl worn over his left shoulder and across the chest, also in brown sandals and a bead bracelet. Have them jointly hold a single bound palm-leaf medical manuscript between them, its bundle tied with a dark cord and wooden covers visible, emphasizing off-white, ochre, cream, deep green and brown as the dominant colours, with clear front and side views to keep face, hair, costume and the shared manuscript consistent.
